history.overview: The Command Center was built to consolidate Muramite strategic control over Kuua.

timeline.name: Command Hall Construction
timeline.description: Dragorn slaves carved the initial command hall.

timeline.name: Officer Installation
timeline.description: Muramite officers established permanent command posts.

timeline.name: Ward Integration
timeline.description: Inquisitors infused the command center with Discord wards.

timeline.name: Warfront Coordination
timeline.description: The Command Center became the nerve‑center of Muramite operations.
